One biomass platform. Different material outcomes.

Application-specific functional materials

NeoNaar develops functional materials by controlling how agricultural residues are separated, purified and physically structured.

Different applications need different material states

A cosmetic rheology modifier does not need the same composition as a packaging coating. A seed-coating material does not require the same degree of purification as a speciality formulation ingredient. Biomethane research may explore retaining components that other applications remove.

What our platform controls

Composition

Cellulose, lignin and associated biomass fractions.

Purification

Removing only what the application requires.

Fibrillation

Controlling fibre and fibrillar structure.

Hydration

Maintaining functional never-dried material states where useful.

Application fit

Engineering materials around customer performance requirements.

One platform, five development directions

Speciality microfibrillated cellulose, agricultural formulation materials, lignocellulosic barrier materials, anaerobic-digestion performance materials and nutrient-recovery liquids.
